[center][font=Georgia]🎍This mod adds bamboo as a new kind of wild tree into game🎍[/font][/center]
[center][font=Georgia] [/font][/center]
[center][font=Georgia]Bamboo grows in all seasons and spreads sprout quickly, but never drops seeds when you chop it or shake it.
When chopped down,  they yield Bamboo Strips, can be used to produce woods or coals.[/font][/center]
[center][font=Georgia]When tapped, they yield Fresh Bamboo Juice every day in spring, or every 2 day in other seasons.
 
The sapling (bamboo shoot) can be purchased from the Traveling Cart in spring & summer.
Also,  it can be pickled to make Sour Bamboo Shoots.[/font]
